SQL:
WITH __slayer_stage_em AS (
  SELECT
    _stage_inner."campaign_members.customer_id" AS "customer_id"
  FROM (
    SELECT
      campaign_members.customer_id AS "campaign_members.customer_id"
    FROM campaign_members AS campaign_members
    LEFT JOIN campaigns AS campaigns
      ON campaign_members.campaign_id = campaigns.id
    WHERE
      campaigns.channel = 'email'
    GROUP BY
      campaign_members.customer_id
  ) AS _stage_inner
)
SELECT
  customers__regions.name AS "orders.customers.regions.name",
  CAST(SUM(orders.amount) AS DOUBLE) AS "orders.amount_sum",
  COUNT(*) AS "orders._count"
FROM orders AS orders
LEFT JOIN customers AS customers
  ON orders.customer_id = customers.id
LEFT JOIN regions AS customers__regions
  ON customers.region_id = customers__regions.id
GROUP BY
  customers__regions.name
LIMIT 21

WITH __slayer_stage_em AS (
  SELECT
    _stage_inner."campaign_members.customer_id" AS "customer_id"
  FROM (
    SELECT
      campaign_members.customer_id AS "campaign_members.customer_id"
    FROM campaign_members AS campaign_members
    LEFT JOIN campaigns AS campaigns
      ON campaign_members.campaign_id = campaigns.id
    WHERE
      campaigns.channel = 'email'
    GROUP BY
      campaign_members.customer_id
  ) AS _stage_inner
)
SELECT
  customers__regions.name AS "orders.customers.regions.name",
  CAST(SUM(orders.amount) AS DOUBLE) AS "orders.amount_sum",
  COUNT(*) AS "orders._count"
FROM orders AS orders
LEFT JOIN customers AS customers
  ON orders.customer_id = customers.id
LEFT JOIN regions AS customers__regions
  ON customers.region_id = customers__regions.id
INNER JOIN __slayer_stage_em AS em
  ON orders.customer_id = em.customer_id
WHERE
  NOT em.customer_id IS NULL
GROUP BY
  customers__regions.name
LIMIT 21
